measured_decisions.decision: Scan raster uses self-encoded PDF RunLength filtering instead of zlib/Flate
measured_decisions.reason: Byte determinism across hosts: zlib-ng and zlib produce different deflate bytes for identical input, which would break byte-identical regeneration between macOS and the Linux reference environment. RLE keeps every manifest entry byte-identical without the pinned-asset escape.
measured_decisions.tradeoff: Slightly larger raster streams (fixtures tree totals 192K, acceptable).

measured_decisions.decision: F03 page raster is printed by the generator's own 5x7 bitmap table rather than an external renderer
measured_decisions.reason: T05 depends only on accepted T01; renderer dependencies belong to T02. The owned bitmap print keeps the family deterministic and dependency-free while preserving the mechanism (raster page + correct invisible layer + clean/displaced siblings). Legibility was visually verified at 1:1 pixels.
measured_decisions.tradeoff: Raster glyph shapes are simple; OCR quality confirmation belongs to T27 with the real recognizer.
